description: This file defines the Image_Graph_Marker class, a data point marker used for marking datapoints on a graph with visual labels, such as icons or text boxes, within the Image_Graph package.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker
classes.description: A class representing a marker for data points on a graph, capable of setting size, secondary markers, and drawing itself.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the marker, calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the marker.

methods.name: setSecondaryMarker
methods.description: Sets a secondary marker and links it to this marker.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Draws the marker at specified coordinates, optionally using a secondary marker.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Indicates completion of drawing, returns true.
